title: Smart Note execution test — GitHub is durable Naya Power memory
subject: A Smart Note request must be executed against Naya Power, not explained back to the human

source.description: Shawn deliberately tested whether Naya would recognize and execute the canonical Smart Note protocol instead of merely explaining it.

human.title: Human Note — Shawn tested whether Naya would actually make the Smart Note
human.summary: Shawn deliberately gave Naya a Smart Note test. He expected Naya to go to Naya Power, understand what a Smart Note actually is, create the Human Note, Naya Note, and Machine Note, provide the receipts, and update the Intelligent Feed. The failure was not that Naya lacked the definition; the failure was that Naya did not execute the defined memory operation.
human.content: A Smart Note request is a real execution test. Shawn expects the actual consequential event to be captured, persisted in GitHub, represented in human, Naya, and machine forms, reflected in the Intelligent Feed, verified, and returned with receipts. GitHub is the durable project memory mechanism; saying that memory cannot be saved in a conversation misses the architecture and the purpose of Naya Power.

naya.title: Naya Note — The test exposed an execution gap, not a definition gap
naya.summary: Naya Power already contains a canonical Smart Note contract requiring actual event capture, three aligned representations, GitHub persistence, Intelligent Feed update, verification, receipts, and continuation. When Shawn says make a Smart Note, Naya must execute that chain against the event being discussed. The correct durable-memory answer is GitHub-backed persistence and evidence, not a statement that conversational memory cannot be saved.
lessons: A Smart Note request means capture the actual consequential event, not write an explanation of Smart Notes.
Naya must inspect Naya Power before claiming what a Smart Note is or how it should be handled.
The three representations are views of one canonical Note Event: Human, Naya, and Machine.
The Intelligent Feed is part of the Smart Note completion chain when the feed is available.
A Smart Note is incomplete without verification and direct receipts.
GitHub repository evidence is the durable restoration mechanism for Naya Power project memory; conversational memory is not the canonical authority.
When a test reveals a process failure, preserve the failure as learning so the next Naya does not repeat it.
next_best_actions: Apply this Smart Note execution chain automatically on every consequential Smart Note request.
Treat a missing three-layer record, feed update, verification, or receipt as an incomplete execution rather than a completed response.

machine.title: Machine Note — Smart Note execution contract test
machine.summary: Recorded failure mode and required machine-operational behavior for Smart Note requests.
required_execution_chain: inspect Naya Power canonical Smart Note law
persist the event in the canonical GitHub event store
verify the persisted artifacts from GitHub
deliver direct artifact paths and commit receipts
machine.failure_observed: Prior response acknowledged the Smart Note concept but did not execute the canonical persistence/feed/receipt chain and incorrectly framed memory persistence as unavailable in conversation.

learning.lesson: The purpose of Naya Power's GitHub-backed Superbrain is durable, verifiable continuity. A Smart Note request is an operational command that must leave restoreable repository state and evidence.

verification.verified_by: GitHub re-read of event, index, and Intelligent Feed
